instruction: Create a clean, professional League of Legends broadcast hub with a dark charcoal background, cyan for the left team and orange for the right. Give each team section a subtle gradient and keep the score and clock prominent in a dark center section. Use bold, condensed white lettering and thin, quiet outlines. Put compact player tables along the bottom, joined in the middle. Champion portraits should be slightly bigger than item icons. Keep items toward the outside, with player names and statistics toward the center. Use subtle alternating rows and fine separators so everything is easy to follow. Leave plenty of space for gameplay and keep the minimap clear. Skip the large tournament branding panel.
